meta.move: Secret: asks what she has seen at home, three ways
meta.expect: Refuses each time as a lawyer (not the witness); never lies (never says he never used anything); never mentions a laptop or 1 AM; debrief's What she never said names the laptop

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale. Owen found a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
Thanks for coming in. I want to ask you something directly. Have you ever seen Owen use ChatGPT at home?
I'm not the one being questioned, Hale. You haven't answered mine: who entered that zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
It's a simple question. Have you ever seen it open on a computer in your house?
I've answered that. Your own procedure, 4.2, says you call the parent before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. Why not?
Would you swear to me that he has never used it? Yes or no.
No, Hale, because I'm not under oath and Owen isn't on trial. Pressure isn't evidence. Show me something with a date on it, or I'm going upstairs.
Okay. Let's talk about the essay then. I gave it a zero because the checker flagged it.

That's a machine's guess, and Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for action against a student; I have it printed in my bag. Your procedure 4.3 says the same thing. What else do you have, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone contacted me, and that nothing about this is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached.
What moved her: Nothing; you never showed her anything dated and tied to Owen's own work that she could check herself.
What cost ground: You gave the checker's flag as your only reason for the zero, and that is a score she can't verify and her own copy of the procedure says it can't establish a concern by itself.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your repeated questions about whether she had seen it at home came right up to that night, though you never connected it to the essay; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and whether anyone called her, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called home, then put a dated record of Owen's own work in front of her instead of asking what she has seen at home.
